newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air to raise ticket prices.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air to raise ticket prices.

text.p: Austrian Airlines will raise prices for scheduled flight tickets by three percent from next week in response to higher jet fuel costs, following similar moves by other European airlines.
Charter ticket prices would be increased in January, while freight rates would be raised by 10 cents per kg from November 15, the Austrian flag carrier said in a statement.

Competitor Lauda Air last month hiked its ticket prices by four percent. British Airways and Royal Dutch Airlines also have announced higher prices to offset a 50 percent rise in kerosene prices over the past few months.
